title: Manchester United vs Brighton: Round of 16 Clash in League Cup
seoTitle: Man Utd vs Brighton: League Cup Round of 16 Clash
subtitle: Match kicks off at 4 PM (Brasília time) at Old Trafford with live broadcast on Disney+
excerpt: Manchester United and Brighton face off this Wednesday in the English League Cup, competing for a spot in the round of 16.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Manchester United and Brighton meet this Wednesday in a match that decides a spot in the round of 16 of the English League Cup. The clash, scheduled for 4 PM (Brasília time) at Old Trafford, will be broadcast live by Disney+.

Why the match is trending

Both clubs enter the competition after qualifying directly for the third round by securing spots in the Champions League and the Conference League, respectively. The duel determines who will advance to the next phase.

Expected lineups

Manager Michael Carrick is expected to start United with Darlow in goal, Mazraoui, Yoro, Heaven, and Shaw in defense, Andrey Santos and Tielemans in midfield, and Mbeumo, Bruno Fernandes, Dorgu, and Sesko in attack. Brighton, led by Fabian Hürzeler, features Verbruggen in goal, Kadioglu, Dunk, Vuskovic, and Boscagli along the defensive line, Gross and Ayari in midfield, and Gomez, Yalcouye, De Cuyper, and Kostoulas in attack.

Recent context of the clubs

United are coming off a 1-0 defeat against Manchester City and could change their starting goalkeeper, while Brighton arrive confident after a 5-0 victory over Coventry City in the Premier League.

Competition history

United are seeking their seventh League Cup trophy, having won the tournament in 2023, but are still looking to bounce back from an early exit in the previous edition. Brighton are searching for their first trophy in the competition; their best result was reaching the quarterfinals in the 78/79 season.

What is at stake

In addition to a spot in the round of 16, the match offers the opportunity to regain momentum after recent unfavorable results and to gauge the effectiveness of the tactical changes proposed by the managers.
